items.title: Figma 发布 Weave 创作平台，用节点化工作流让创意流程可复用
items.summary: Figma 宣布 Figma Weave，一个面向持续产出需求的创意团队平台，并把 Weave 创作工作流与 Figma 画框连接起来。Weave 用连接的节点承载图像和视频的生成与编辑，支持分支探索、多模型对比、色彩校正、合成、裁剪、Painter 等编辑节点；工作流可打包成 Weave tool 让团队成员一键运行，社区工具发布已上线。
items.title_original: The TL;DR on Figma Weave: Make your creative process repeatable
items.title_en: The TL;DR on Figma Weave: Make your creative process repeatable
items.title_zh: Figma 发布 Weave 创作平台，用节点化工作流让创意流程可复用
items.title_bilingual: Figma 发布 Weave 创作平台，用节点化工作流让创意流程可复用 / The TL;DR on Figma Weave: Make your creative process repeatable
items.recommend_reason_zh: Figma Weave把AI生成与编辑工具串成可复用的节点工作流，并用branch从同一张背包照片分叉比较不同prompt和模型结果，适合持续产出活动视觉的团队。

en.summary: Figma announces Figma Weave, a platform for creative teams with continuous output needs, connecting Weave creation workflows with Figma frames. Weave uses connected nodes to handle image and video generation and editing, with support for branching exploration, multi-model comparison, color correction, compositing, cropping, Painter, and other editing nodes. Workflows can be packaged as Weave tools for team members to run with one click, and community tool publishing is now live.
en.reason: Figma Weave links AI image and video generation and editing nodes into reusable workflows, lets teams branch from one backpack photo to compare prompts and models, and packages workflows as one-click Weave tools for teammates.

en.title: Alibaba partners with Apple to integrate Qwen into Apple Intelligence, with testing opening November 4
en.summary: Alibaba announced a partnership with Apple on October 31 to integrate Qwen into Apple Intelligence, allowing users in China to access Qwen's text and image understanding and content generation capabilities through Siri, Writing Tools, and Visual Intelligence. The features will be available for testing starting November 4 with the iOS developer beta, and will launch officially with iOS 27.3 in December; users can opt in, and requests and responses will not be used for model training.
en.reason: Alibaba and Apple will integrate Qwen into Apple Intelligence, letting Chinese users call Qwen's text and image understanding and content generation from Siri, Writing Tools and Visual Intelligence, with developer beta testing from November 4 and a full iOS 27.3 release in December, opt-in only and with requests and replies excluded from model training.

items.title: Project Suncatcher 在轨道卫星上运行 TPU，Gemma 模型首次在太空完成推理并回传回应
items.summary: Philipp Schmid 转引 Sundar Pichai 的消息：Google Project Suncatcher 在数周前发射原型卫星后，成功向轨道发送指令、启动 TPU、运行提示词，并在地面收到了首个完整回应（一首 haiku），作者称 Gemma 4 成为首个在太空运行的大语言模型。
items.title_original: This incredible. Gemma 4 became the first LLM to run in space?
items.title_en: This incredible. Gemma 4 became the first LLM to run in space?
items.title_zh: Project Suncatcher 在轨道卫星上运行 TPU，Gemma 模型首次在太空完成推理并回传回应

items.recommend_reason_zh: 标题称Gemma 4成为首个在太空运行的大语言模型，但正文仅重复该标题并附"查看最新动态并加入对话"提示，未给出任务名称、硬件或验证细节，读者可据此判断信息量。

en.summary: Philipp Schmid, citing Sundar Pichai: weeks after launching a prototype satellite, Google's Project Suncatcher successfully sent commands to orbit, powered up a TPU, ran a prompt, and received the first full response back on the ground (a haiku). The author says Gemma 4 is now the first large language model to run in space.
en.reason: Google's Project Suncatcher reportedly sent commands to a prototype satellite, booted a TPU in orbit and received a haiku from Gemma 4, which Philipp Schmid calls the first LLM run in space — though the post offers few verification details.

en.summary: Anthropic is renaming its Claude subscription tiers: Max 5x becomes Max and Max 20x becomes Ultra, with prices unchanged ($100/month for Max, $200/month for Ultra). Effective today, most existing subscribers with verified Ultra accounts will have the 5-hour limit lifted; new accounts keep a temporary limit to prevent fraud and abuse, and weekly limits remain unchanged.

en.summary: Epoch AI experiments found that GLM 5.3, the open-weight model Z.ai released in August, can exploit security patches Mozilla has published but not yet pushed to users (the patch gap) to autonomously build web attacks that read files on a visitor’s computer just by visiting a page, compromising all six Firefox versions released between September 17 and October 26.
en.reason: Epoch AI found Z.ai's GLM 5.3 used about $1,000 of compute to reverse-engineer Mozilla's published-but-unshipped Firefox patches into web attacks in as little as 12 hours, breaking all six versions released September 17 to October 26 and reading visitors' files.

items.summary: 月之暗面（Kimi）发布官方教程，详解 Kimi K3.1 Pro 的 3D 创作工作流程，说明参数化建模与网格化建模两种方式及对应工具选择。文章分享了 4 个案例的具体操作，包括在 Unreal Engine 中构建东方天宫、制作可 3D 打印的台灯、纯代码调用 Blender 生成建筑、用 Tripo 和 Blender 搭建微缩城市，并给出图胜于言、先搭灰模再细化等 5 个使用技巧。

en.title: Kimi official tutorial: How to create 3D artwork with Kimi K3.1 Pro
en.summary: Moonshot AI (Kimi) has released an official tutorial detailing the 3D creation workflow for Kimi K3.1 Pro, covering parametric modeling and mesh modeling along with how to choose the right tools for each. The post walks through four case studies: building an Eastern heavenly palace in Unreal Engine, making a 3D-printable desk lamp, generating architecture by calling Blender purely through code, and building a miniature city with Tripo and Blender. It also shares five tips, including "show, don't tell" and blocking out a grey model before adding detail.
en.reason: Kimi's official tutorial details how Kimi K3.1 Pro handles 3D creation via parametric and mesh modeling, walking through 4 cases—an Eastern heavenly palace in Unreal Engine, a 3D-printable lamp, pure-code Blender architecture and a Tripo-plus-Blender miniature city—plus 5 tips like blocking out a grey model first.

en.title: Finally, something that isn't AI: running Express directly on Lambda—is API Gateway still needed?
en.summary:
AWS launches Lambda Web Functions for Node.js applications.

Word count: 1,511 · Reading time: about 5 minutes

Lambda Web Functions is a new Lambda runtime mode from AWS that natively supports Node.js web frameworks such as Express and Hono, offering concurrent HTTP request handling and streaming responses, with billing based on active CPU time.

It supports multi-region routing and reuse of warmed environments to significantly reduce cold starts; no adapters or framework changes are required, and it is compatible with existing Lambda functions; custom domains, WAF and edge caching can be configured through CloudFront integration.

Intended for Node.js full-stack developers, serverless architects, and cloud-native application operations engineers.

AWS recently introduced Lambda Web Functions, letting developers run Node.js web applications built with frameworks such as Express and Hono directly on Lambda, with support for concurrent requests and streaming responses.

According to the Lambda Web Functions documentation, the new func...
en.reason: Amazon Web Services' Lambda Web Functions let Node.js apps built with Express or Hono run natively with concurrent HTTP requests and streaming responses, billed by active CPU time, currently limited to Node.js and five regions.

en.title: Finally, something that isn't AI: running Express directly on Lambda—is API Gateway still needed?
en.summary:
AWS launches Lambda Web Functions for Node.js applications.

Word count: 1,511 · Reading time: about 5 minutes

Lambda Web Functions is a new Lambda runtime mode from AWS that natively supports Node.js web frameworks such as Express and Hono, offering concurrent HTTP request handling and streaming responses, with billing based on active CPU time.

It supports multi-region routing and reuse of warmed environments to significantly reduce cold starts; no adapters or framework changes are required, and it is compatible with existing Lambda functions; custom domains, WAF and edge caching can be configured through CloudFront integration.

Intended for Node.js full-stack developers, serverless architects, and cloud-native application operations engineers.

AWS recently introduced Lambda Web Functions, letting developers run Node.js web applications built with frameworks such as Express and Hono directly on Lambda, with support for concurrent requests and streaming responses.

en.reason: Amazon Web Services' Lambda Web Functions let Node.js apps built with Express or Hono run natively with concurrent HTTP requests and streaming responses, billed by active CPU time, currently limited to Node.js and five regions.
